name: rockslide
title: ROCKSLIDE: Mountain Patrol
pitch: You are Vince, twenty, long blonde hair with a bit of a curl, the newest hand on the Kessel Patrol. You run the mountain patrol for the Kessel valley: its slopes, its roads, its village and the people who get lost on it. You have a log station, a snowmobile, a helicopter, a pair of old skis, and Koda, a grey-and-white husky with one ear that never stands up.
